verses.he: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then Job answered and said:

verses.he: אָ֭מְנָם כִּ֣י אַתֶּם־עָ֑ם וְ֝עִמָּכֶ֗ם תָּמ֥וּת חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: No doubt but ye are the people, And wisdom shall die with you.

verses.he: גַּם־לִ֤י לֵבָ֨ב׀ כְּֽמוֹכֶ֗ם לֹא־נֹפֵ֣ל אָנֹכִ֣י מִכֶּ֑ם וְאֶת־מִי־אֵ֥ין כְּמוֹ־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; Yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

verses.he: שְׂחֹ֤ק לְרֵעֵ֨הוּ׀ אֶֽהְיֶ֗ה קֹרֵ֣א לֶ֭אֱלוֹהַּ וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑הוּ שְׂ֝ח֗וֹק צַדִּ֥יק תָּמִֽים׃
verses.en: I am as one that is a laughing-stock to his neighbour, A man that called upon God, And He answered him; The just, the innocent man is a laughing-stock,

verses.he: לַפִּ֣יד בּ֭וּז לְעַשְׁתּ֣וּת שַׁאֲנָ֑ן נָ֝כ֗וֹן לְמ֣וֹעֲדֵי רָֽגֶל׃
verses.en: A contemptible brand in the thought of him that is at ease, A thing ready for them whose foot slippeth.

verses.he: יִשְׁלָ֤יוּ אֹֽהָלִ֨ים׀ לְשֹׁ֥דְדִ֗ים וּֽ֭בַטֻּחוֹת לְמַרְגִּ֣יזֵי אֵ֑ל לַאֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבִ֖יא אֱל֣וֹהַּ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The tents of robbers prosper, And they that provoke God are secure, In whatsoever God bringeth into their hand.

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁאַל־נָ֣א בְהֵמ֣וֹת וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וְע֥וֹף הַ֝שָּׁמַ֗יִם וְיַגֶּד־לָֽךְ׃
verses.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; And the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee;

verses.he: א֤וֹ שִׂ֣יחַ לָאָ֣רֶץ וְתֹרֶ֑ךָּ וִֽיסַפְּר֥וּ לְ֝ךָ֗ דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּֽם׃
verses.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; And the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee;

verses.he: מִ֭י לֹא־יָדַ֣ע בְּכָל־אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֥י יַד־יְ֝הוָה עָ֣שְׂתָה זֹּֽאת׃
verses.en: Who knoweth not among all these, That the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל־חָ֑י וְ֝ר֗וּחַ כָּל־בְּשַׂר־אִֽישׁ׃
verses.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, And the breath of all mankind.—

verses.he: הֲלֹא־אֹ֭זֶן מִלִּ֣ין תִּבְחָ֑ן וְ֝חֵ֗ךְ אֹ֣כֶל יִטְעַם־לֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Doth not the ear try words, Even as the palate tasteth its food?

verses.he: בִּֽישִׁישִׁ֥ים חָכְמָ֑ה וְאֹ֖רֶךְ יָמִ֣ים תְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: Is wisdom with aged men, And understanding in length of days?—

verses.he: עִ֭מּוֹ חָכְמָ֣ה וּגְבוּרָ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ עֵצָ֥ה וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.en: With Him is wisdom and might; He hath counsel and understanding.

verses.he: הֵ֣ן יַ֭הֲרוֹס וְלֹ֣א יִבָּנֶ֑ה יִסְגֹּ֥ר עַל־אִ֝֗ישׁ וְלֹ֣א יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.en: Behold, He breaketh down, and it cannot be built again; He shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

verses.he: הֵ֤ן יַעְצֹ֣ר בַּמַּ֣יִם וְיִבָ֑שׁוּ וִֽ֝ישַׁלְּחֵ֗ם וְיַ֖הַפְכוּ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Behold, He withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; Also He sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

verses.he: עִ֭מּוֹ עֹ֣ז וְתֽוּשִׁיָּ֑ה ל֝֗וֹ שֹׁגֵ֥ג וּמַשְׁגֶּֽה׃
verses.en: With Him is strength and sound wisdom; The deceived and the deceiver are His.

verses.he: מוֹלִ֣יךְ יוֹעֲצִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְֽשֹׁפְטִ֥ים יְהוֹלֵֽל׃
verses.en: He leadeth counsellors away stripped, And judges maketh He fools.

verses.he: מוּסַ֣ר מְלָכִ֣ים פִּתֵּ֑חַ וַיֶּאְסֹ֥ר אֵ֝ז֗וֹר בְּמָתְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.en: He looseth the bond of kings, And bindeth their loins with a girdle.

verses.he: מוֹלִ֣יךְ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים שׁוֹלָ֑ל וְאֵֽתָנִ֣ים יְסַלֵּֽף׃
verses.en: He leadeth priests away stripped, And overthroweth the mighty.

verses.he: מֵסִ֣יר שָׂ֭פָה לְנֶאֱמָנִ֑ים וְטַ֖עַם זְקֵנִ֣ים יִקָּֽח׃
verses.en: He removeth the speech of men of trust, And taketh away the sense of the elders.

verses.he: שׁוֹפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־נְדִיבִ֑ים וּמְזִ֖יחַ אֲפִיקִ֣ים רִפָּֽה׃
verses.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, And looseth the belt of the strong.

verses.he: מְגַלֶּ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקוֹת מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיֹּצֵ֖א לָא֣וֹר צַלְמָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: He uncovereth deep things out of darkness, And bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

verses.he: מַשְׂגִּ֣יא לַ֭גּוֹיִם וַֽיְאַבְּדֵ֑ם שֹׁטֵ֥חַ לַ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם וַיַּנְחֵֽם׃
verses.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them; He enlargeth the nations, and leadeth them away.

verses.he: מֵסִ֗יר לֵ֭ב רָאשֵׁ֣י עַם־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.en: He taketh away the heart of the chiefs of the people of the land, And causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

verses.he: יְמַֽשְׁשׁוּ־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־א֑וֹר וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם כַּשִּׁכּֽוֹר׃
verses.en: They grope in the dark without light, And He maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
